exactQuestion: Does the current Deep Resolver queue contain actionable new contradictions, or is its leading backlog stale/dependent work already resolved or owned by root owners?
whyItMatters: Resolver must not repeat adjudications, duplicate Council Alpha underwriting, or manufacture liveness from stale routing.
lawfulFallbacks: Leave unchanged resolved items dormant until deterministic reconciliation consumes their dispositions.
Defer Alpha-owned missing source/numeric underwriting work.
Reopen a company only on a materially changed input signature or genuinely independent contradiction.
successCondition: Identify the earliest lawful Resolver frontier without repeating prior strategies or stealing root-owner authority.

disposition.finding: The leading Resolver queue is stale/dependent rather than a clean new adjudication frontier. LLY and LNG remain routed for unresolved_material_contradiction despite immutable Resolver evidence already resolving those contradictions as non-gating. LMT also carries explicit resolved dispositions in its routed payload. MBLY's routed contradiction names Council Alpha as next owner while source-integrity/company-underwriting evidence remains missing. No Deep Resolver assist request, role cycle, or dependency deadlock is active.
disposition.repeatedBlocker: Deterministic reconciliation is not consuming existing resolved Resolver dispositions, so resolved contradictions are re-emitted into Resolver ownership.
disposition.failedStrategy: Re-adjudicating semantically identical contradiction records after immutable Resolver resolution.
disposition.changedStrategy: Stop company-level repetition; diagnose the routing consumer itself, preserve prior dispositions, and escalate the exact deterministic-consumption defect to Chief while deferring Alpha-owned work.
disposition.chiefDecisionRequired: Repair or adjudicate deterministic reconciliation so valid immutable deep-resolver resolution=resolved,gating=false dispositions clear unresolved_material_contradiction when no independent contradiction remains, without deleting the underlying risk evidence.
disposition.directive: Do not reroute LLY or LNG on the unchanged contradiction signatures. Consume their existing immutable dispositions. Treat LMT's embedded resolved dispositions likewise unless an independent unresolved claim remains. Keep MBLY deferred to Council Alpha until root-owner evidence changes or a genuinely independent contradiction emerges.
